fact: The July 2024 terms of reference for the Liberia Business Registry's online registration system specify a primary site, a secondary site at the registry, and a DR site at a separate, geographically distant location proposed at Liberia Telecommunications Corporation (LIBTELCO), with backup replication and failover to the DR site required of the bidder.
title: Terms of Reference for the Development of an Online Business Registration System for the Liberia Business Registry
publisher: Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Liberia Investment, Finance & Trade Project (LIFT-P)
